I have successfully retrieved the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. My next step is to communicate their availability to Brad so he can cross-reference it with the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor.

To do this, I will first identify all the common 30-minute free slots for Priya and Marcus during the specified week. A systematic day-by-day analysis is the most reliable method.

-   **Monday:** Free at 9:00-9:30 and 9:30-10:00.
-   **Tuesday:** Free at 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00, and 16:30-17:00.
-   **Wednesday:** Free at 15:00-15:30 and 15:30-16:00.
-   **Thursday:** Free at 10:00-10:30.
-   **Friday:** Free at 11:00-11:30 and 11:30-12:00.

Now that I have this list of available slots, I will post it to the shared workspace for Brad. This will allow him to find a time that works for all four partners. After posting, I will end my session.
